}

Why This Is Asked
- Tests lock-free synchronization fundamentals in a practical pattern (SPMC) with concrete constraints.

Key Concepts
- fetch_add/CAS-based slot reservation, per-slot sequence counters to avoid ABA, and memory-order considerations.
- Cache-line padding to prevent false sharing and reduce cross-slot traffic.
- Correctness under contention and bounded capacity handling.

Code Example

```c
#define N (1<<12)
typedef struct { volatile uint64_t seq; uint8_t data[64]; } slot_t;
slot_t ring[N];

uint64_t read_idx[NUM_CONSUMERS]; // one per consumer

```

Follow-up Questions
- How would you adapt this for dynamic resizing or multiple producers?
